Lina K: Quick onboarding request — can someone run a smoke + kv-cache microbench for EdgeWave-7B on p3-16x? Target p95 <= 350ms at batch=4 for seq=2048. Also compare fp16 vs q4_0. Add the litmus prompt set `onboard_edgewave_v1`.
Jake H: I can start tonight. Which variant tag should I use? edgewave-7b.v1 or edgewave-7b-rc?
Lina K: Use edgewave-7b.v1 and also try edgewave-7b.q4_0 for quantized. Please capture p50/p95/throughput/mem + a KV miss/hit breakdown.
Evan B: I'll run q4 + fp16 and collect perf traces. Command I'm going to use:
```
python infra/bench/run.py --model edgewave-7b.v1 --batch 4 --seq 2048 --profile=kv_cache --output json
python infra/bench/run.py --model edgewave-7b.q4_0 --batch 4 --seq 2048 --profile=kv_cache --output json
```
deploy-bot: Bench job queued (job id: bch-8932). Estimated runtime: ~40m.
Rachel M: Heads up — previous models with rotary embeddings showed a hotspot in attention kernels. Please include kernel traces.
Jake H: Started fp16 run on p3-16x now. Will paste results when done.
Jake H: fp16 run complete. Quick summary:
```
model: edgewave-7b.v1
p50: 0.180s
p95: 0.420s
throughput: 125 tok/s
gpu_mem: 28.4 GB
kv_cache_miss_penalty: ~45ms
```
Evan B: q4_0 run done. Summary:
```
model: edgewave-7b.q4_0
p50: 0.210s
p95: 0.355s
throughput: 98 tok/s
gpu_mem: 15.6 GB
kv_cache_miss_penalty: ~30ms
```
Jake H: Interesting — q4 reduces memory and improves p95 but lowers peak tok/s. Likely quantized matmul tradeoff.
Lina K: Good signal. Can we get a profiling trace for the fp16 p95 spike? If KV miss adds 45ms that's actionable.
Evan B: Attaching trace snippet (hot kernels):
```
attention_forward: 120ms
matmul_qk: 80ms
kv_cache_lookup (miss): 45ms
softmax: 25ms
```
Zane P: I can follow up on kernel scheduling and look at dynamic batching policies. Also, I'll review the config changes.
Evan B: Opening PR to add q4_0 to our runtime mapping + a recommended batch=4 profile. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1428 :eyes: 
Zane P: Reviewed. small nit on naming (`q4_0` vs `q4a`). Fixed in a follow-up commit. LGTM :shipit: 
Lina K: Thanks team. Plan: mark EdgeWave-7B as 'supported' for Hosted + Dedicated (with q4 recommended) pending one more nightly regression run. I'll publish the bench summary to /docs/onboarding/next.md after nightly.
deploy-bot: Bench job bch-8932 completed successfully. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/edgewave/1934567890/
Jake H: noted, will kick nightly regression tomorrow morning and post results.
Lina K: Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
